description: Paired frozen baseline vs Token-pair SCDA generations. Both use the same per-image deterministic noise (same prompt, same seed), so a pair differs only in the model. Scores are the per-image T2I-CompBench++ BLIP-VQA values from the same evaluation run.
selection: Rows 1-6: the two largest per-image score drops in each of color / texture / shape. Last row: the closest-to-equal case in color, included so the figure is not composed only of extreme failures.
protocol: 300 prompts per category, 1 image per prompt, 512x512, DPM-Solver 20 steps, CFG 4.0, official T2I-CompBench++ evaluators
caveat: BLIP-VQA is a proxy for attribute presence, not a recognition accuracy.
